description: Angular component for a Markdown widget in the Thingsboard UI, handling rendering and styling of markdown content with optional custom functions and CSS.

classes.name: MarkdownWidgetSettings
classes.description: Configuration settings for the Markdown widget, including pattern, function, style, and CSS.

classes.name: MarkdownTextFunction
classes.description: Type alias for a function generating markdown text from data and context.

classes.name: MarkdownWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a markdown widget with dynamic data, styling, and custom functions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up functions, styles, and data subscriptions.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Updates the markdown text based on current data and functions.

methods.name: updateMarkdownText
methods.description: Processes and updates the markdown text for display.

methods.name: markdownClick
methods.description: Handles click events on the markdown content.
